Frontend admin has all 8 tabs with correct testids; Zones restricted toggle, Movement dialog with 24/72/168 windows, Family tab (Send test + Add family dialogs), Insights tab with Recompute, and StaffDashboard 5th 'PATTERN FLAGS' tile linking to /admin all verified live. issues: A11y console warnings: Radix DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` (MovementDialog, Zone Add, Send test, Add family). Non-blocking but should add <DialogDescription> for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional) Add <DialogDescription> to Radix Dialog components to silence a11y warnings.
(Cleanup) Stale 'TEST Zone 4cad' exists in DB from a previous test run without is_restricted field set (predates model update). Harmless but can be deleted via /api/zones/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/location.py geofence check computes `prev_zone` using skip(1).limit(1) sorted desc AFTER insertion — this correctly returns the prior document; re-fire suppression works as tested.

routes/insights.py deviation formula uses denom=1 when baseline_value=0, so 19 current vs 0 baseline renders as +1800%. Acceptable for a signal but consider capping display at e.g. +999% or switching to absolute-delta framing when baseline=0 to avoid misleading percentages.

notifications.py `NotificationTest` pager/inapp branch creates a raw dict with notification_id='notif_log' (literal string, not generated) — if ever exercised it would break the unique identity convention. Consider using `Notification(...).model_dump()` like the sms/email paths.
alerts.py create_alert fan-out is wrapped in bare try/except Exception pass — failures will be silently swallowed. Add at least a logging.warning so ops can diagnose Twilio/Resend misconfigurations.

models.py FamilyContact.notify_on literal union omits 'assist' for wander-only contacts — but notify_family_for_alert maps non-geofence severities directly to severity key (emergency/assist/comfort). A 'comfort' alert won't match any notify_on key since 'comfort' is not in the Literal; this silently skips comfort alerts (probably desired, but worth an explicit comment).
